targeting_gate.verbatim_anchor:
Although SDMs can reveal statistical associations between the potential wetland distribution and environmental factors, 
changes in wetlands also influence the surrounding environment. For example, water accumulation in wetlands may alter local hy­
drological processes, affect soil properties, and drive vegetation succession. Therefore, understanding the ecological mechanisms 
affecting wetland formation and persistence remains a significant challenge due to the interaction and feedback between wetlands and 
environmental factors.
